title: The 8 Best Router Table and Table Saw Combination 2026
h1: The 8 Best Router Table and Table Saw Combination 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for router table and table saw combination 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at router table and table saw combination 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bench Dog 40-032 ProTop Standard Router Table Top
products.blurb: Key specs: Phenolic top surface, Adjustable split fence, Standard router plate size.
strengths: Phenolic top is slippery, durable, and flat, better surface than laminate alternatives
Split fence adjusts for bit diameter variations and anti-friction pads
Standard router plate dimensions fit most aftermarket insert plates and routers
Mounts to table saw wings or on its own stand, flexible installation
limitations: No stand included, requires a table saw wing mount or separate stand purchase

products.name: Woodpeckers RT2743-PH Phenolic Router Table Top
products.blurb: Key specs: 1-inch thick phenolic top, Precision milled, Miter slot machined in.
strengths: 1-inch thick phenolic is the flattest table surface in this category
Precision milled miter slot accepts standard miter gauges
Compatible with Rockler and aftermarket router table fence systems
Rockler customer support and accessory ecosystem
limitations: No stand, requires wall mount or table saw wing integration
features: Compatible with router table fence systems

products.name: Kreg PRS1045 Precision Router Table System
products.blurb: Key specs: Complete fence system with adjustable faces, Router lift compatible, Precision miter gauge included.
strengths: Complete system: table, fence, and miter gauge in one purchase
Router lift compatible, works with most popular lift systems for bit height adjustment
Adjustable fence faces accommodate different bit diameters without shimming
Modular design allows expanding with additional accessories
limitations: Higher price than purchasing table and fence separately
Kreg-specific accessories required for some expansion features
features: Complete fence system with adjustable faces

products.name: RIDGID R4512 10-inch Cast Iron Table Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Table saw with integrated router table position, Universal router table attachment, 32-inch rip capacity.
strengths: Single machine handles both table saw and router functions, maximizes small shop floor space
Universal router table attachment works with most fixed-base routers
Lifetime service agreement covers both the saw and attachments
32-inch rip capacity is full-size for a contractor saw
limitations: Router table is positioned to the right of the blade, requires reaching over the blade area
Router table position is not as convenient as a separate dedicated table
features: Table saw with integrated router table position

products.name: Bosch RA1181 Benchtop Router Table
products.blurb: Key specs: Cabinet-style enclosed stand, Dust collection port, Adjustable split fence.
strengths: Enclosed cabinet stand contains chips and connects to shop vacuum
Two featherboards included, maintain workpiece contact against the fence
Self-contained unit, no table saw needed for installation
Fold-down side extensions increase the table area for large workpieces
limitations: MDF top is heavier and less durable than phenolic alternatives
Fence does not have the rigidity of premium alternatives

products.name: Porter-Cable 892 Fixed Base Router, 2-1/4 HP
products.blurb: Key specs: 1-3/4 HP motor, Fixed base, table mounting, Variable speed: 10,000–27,500 RPM.
strengths: Fixed base is the correct router type for table mounting, plunge bases are unnecessary in a table
Variable speed is essential for large bits, large profile bits require slower RPM to run safely
Soft-start motor reduces startup torque that can deflect the bit on initial engagement
Porter-Cable 698 is the reference standard budget-grade table router, compatible with most router tables
limitations: 1-3/4 HP limits to smaller and mid-size bits, large panel-raising bits require 2+ HP
Router not included with most router tables, this is a separate recommended purchase

products.name: Festool OF 1400 EQ Plunge Router
products.blurb: Key specs: 1400W motor, Electronic speed control with feedback, Plunge base with fine depth adjustment.
strengths: Electronic speed control with feedback maintains constant RPM under load, critical for large panel-raising bits
1400W motor handles large router bits without bogging down
Festool CMS system integrates seamlessly, one ecosystem for table and freehand routing
Festool quality and longevity in production shop environments
limitations: Festool CMS system is a separate high-cost purchase, the router alone does not create a complete table
features: Plunge base with fine depth adjustment
Festool CMS router table system compatible
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: JessEm 02120 Mast-R-Lift II Universal Router Lift
products.blurb: Key specs: Micro-adjustable bit height above the table, Through-the-table bit changes, Compatible with most 3.25-inch base routers.
strengths: Micro-adjustable bit height from above the table, no reaching under to adjust
Through-the-table bit changes eliminate removing the router to change bits
Precision ground lift plate provides a flat, level mounting surface
Compatible with most standard router bases, integrates existing router
limitations: High price for an accessory, must be combined with a router and table
Requires router table with a specific lift cutout, verify compatibility
features: Micro-adjustable bit height above the table

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
